policy.acceptable: Optional dependency probes, logging, cleanup, or shell-only formatting paths may keep a broad catch when the fallback is explicit and does not change trust-critical verdicts.
policy.questionable: Active paths that coerce config, pair data, or shape user-visible outputs need a narrower catch or stronger justification before they should remain broad.
policy.should_remove: Trust-critical determinism, guard evidence, guard execution, and pairing logic must not rely on blanket catches because they can hide correctness gaps or downgrade fail-closed behavior.
